16 | Mystical Shift I | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

19 | Skill Shift I True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
20 | Skill Shift II True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

30 | Mystical Shift True | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U
50 | Mindshifting True | caster | 24 hours | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster gains and stores all mental and emotional information about target.
This information is only accessible via the higher level spells on this list.
@@ 2
Allows caster to know the general emotions/outlook of a studied humanoid,
either in terms of a typical member of the race or the specific individual.
@@ 3
Allows caster to know the general emotions/ outlook of a studied sentient
plant, animal or beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or
the specific individual.
@@ 4
Allows caster to know the gender, race, profession and level (if any) of a
studied individual at time of Study.
@@ 5
Allows caster to know the number, nature, and value of all skills (excluding
spell lists; if any) possessed by a studied individual at time of Study.
@@ 6
Allows caster to know the number, nature, and levels known of all spell lists
(if any) and special mental abilities (if any) possessed by an individual at
time of Study.
@@ 7
Caster can consult the conscious memories and experiences of a studied
individual at a rate of one “scene” per round.
@@ 8
Caster can mimic the emotions/outlook of a studied humanoid, either in terms
of a typical member of the race or the specific individual.
@@ 9
Caster can mimic the emotions/outlook of a studied sentient plant, animal or
beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or the specific
individual.
@@ 10
Caster can mentally become the gender, race, level and/or profession of any
Studied race or individual, and will register as such by magical detections.
Caster retains his own skills, profession, and racial bonuses. Also, any
attribute that the caster does not choose to shift, he will retain. For
example, a male Gnomish Shapeshifter (10th level Mentalist) has previously
Studied a female Wood Elf Ranger (12th level), and now elects to Mental Shift,
choosing to shift only race and profession. Assuming the spell is successful,
he will now detect as a male 10th level Wood Elf Ranger (and may think like a
Wood Elf Ranger).
@@ 11
Caster can draw upon the conscious memories of the Studied pattern in response
to current stimuli.
@@ 12
Caster can use the studied individual’s native language to the level of
fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.
@@ 13
Caster can use one purely mental skill (a skill that uses any combination of
the following stat bonuses: Memory, Reasoning, Empathy, Intuition, or
Presence) of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at
time of Study.
@@ 14
Caster can use one non-combat (not OB related) physical or mental skill of a
Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.
@@ 15
Caster can use one combat skill (OB related) of a Studiedindividual at the
skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.
@@ 16
Caster may use one spell list known by a Studied individual to the level known
by that individual at time of Study. However, the caster must use his own PPs
and must always make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate
penalties taken into consideration. Should the spell casting maneuver fail,
the spell failure roll will receive a special modification of +50.
@@ 18
Caster can use any language known by the studied individual to the level of
fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.
@@ 19
As Skill Shift I, except the caster can use up to one purely mental skill per
level from a single Studied individual.
@@ 20
As Skill Shift II, except the caster can use up to one non-combat physical or
mental skill per level from a single Studied individual.
@@ 25
As SkillShiftIII, except the caster can use up to one combat skill per level
from a single Studied individual.
@@ 30
As MysticalShift I, except the caster can use up to one spell list per level
from a single Studied individual.
@@ 50
As any of the lower level Shift spells except caster can mind shift to a
different pattern at any time during the 24 hours by concentrating for one
full round.
